name: Atalay Mudanyali
summary: Backend developer with production experience shipping an AI-powered app (Bondly) to the App Store and Google Play. Specialized in .NET Core and Java Spring Boot, with hands-on work integrating LLM APIs (GPT-4, Whisper, TTS), designing scalable REST APIs, and optimizing PostgreSQL data layers. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality.

highlights: Erasmus Exchange Student — University of Applied Sciences Upper Austria, Hagenberg (Feb – July 2024)
Full scholarship — one of Turkey's most prestigious merit-based institutions, admitted via national entrance exam

experience.context: Shipped Bondly — an AI-powered relationship coach app — to App Store, live in production with real users.
bullets: Integrated OpenAI GPT-4, Whisper, and TTS APIs to enable conversational AI, real-time voice chat, and intelligent message orchestration in a production environment
Reduced AI audio response latency from 10+ seconds to 2-5 seconds through async pipeline optimization and real-time cut-off handling that updates conversation history when users stop listening
Designed scalable REST APIs in .NET Core using Clean Architecture; containerized services with Docker for consistent multi-environment deployments
Implemented secure authentication flows (Google & Apple Sign-In, JWT with refresh rotation) and AES encryption for sensitive payloads and media pipelines (audio/image)
Optimized PostgreSQL data layer with EF Core migrations, query tuning, and analytics support for conversational workloads
Built automated media cleanup workflows running every 15 minutes to maintain storage hygiene and ensure stable production performance
Used Cursor and Claude as AI-assisted development tools throughout the project to accelerate implementation and validate architectural decisions
Built backend features for a web-based exam platform using Java Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and PostgreSQL
Implemented user authentication and role-based access control with Spring Security, including OTP-based login
Applied Onion Architecture and DTOs to improve modularity and separation of concerns
Wrote unit and integration tests; validated API endpoints with Postman in an agile team environment
